messages.text:
I was see the lead monitor bash return this error. let's investigate, do workaround and do long-term fix

⏺ Monitor event: "lead triage listener (thread wait --monitor, I-147): user threads needing the lead, escalations, proposal decisions"
  Cannot destructure property 'news' of 'split(...)' as it is null.
  WAKE listener-exit rc=1
Message queued for delivery to mgmt-devices at its next tool round.
Allowed by auto mode classifier

It's a crash in the listener tool, and no message was lost. The other listener had already delivered each one.
- Cause: I run two listeners as the same reader, "lead", as a workaround for the earlier missed messages.
- When you post, the faster one marks the message as read. The slower one then finds nothing new, and a code slip makes it crash (console.mjs line 410) instead of carrying on.
- Which cases: only when two listeners share one reader. Today that is only the lead. Workers run one listener each.
- Workaround (in place): each listener restarts itself after 30 s, and the other one keeps delivering. Every message so far reached me, this one included.
- Long-term fix: ts-i181, the tool-fix agent already working on the missed-messages bug (I-181). It makes the slower listener skip quietly, with a test for two listeners. I land it as soon as it's ready, then run one listener again.

What you need to do: nothing.
